newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland works on liberalised currency regulations.
newsitem.headline: Poland works on liberalised currency regulations.

text.p: The Polish finance ministry is working on a plan to liberalise currency regulations, Finance Minister Marek Belka said on Wednesday.
"The proposal should leave the ministry in about 10 days... Changes go towards liberalisation," Belka told a news conference. He said it was too early to give more details.

Presently the zloty is fully convertible domestically and transfers of foreign currencies abroad are allowed but the zloty still cannot be used as the settlement currency in foreign trade transactions outside the Polish banking system.
